config.goal: reduce Xbox streaming end-to-end latency on iOS

findings: ForcePlayoutDelay min/max 0 removed the 14.8 ms jitter-buffer component (iteration 1).
Barcode latency is lab-only now; the live path skips IOSurface readback (iteration 2).
Re-baseline at 0e65b96 with a microsecond barcode and 60 samples: 6.01 ms median.
Encode-time split: e2e 6.0 = encode 4.0 + decode 1.6 + jitter buffer 0.1 + rtt 0.4.
Submit metric (renderFrame entry -> AVSampleBufferDisplayLayer enqueue) is 0.45 ms median on Mac Catalyst; the async render-queue hop is not a bottleneck.
Mac Catalyst lab baseline: e2e 10.9 = encT 9.1 + dec 1.2 + sub 0.45 + jb 0.5 + rtt 0.9 (46 samples, ren ~59, drop 0). The harness encoder dominates; client receive path is ~2.2 ms.
The client-controlled receive path is ~2 ms; the rest is the lab's synthetic H.264 encoder.
libwebrtc already runs the video decode queue at TaskQueueFactory::Priority::HIGH.

Live xHome session verified on 'My Mac (Mac Catalyst)': saved session restored without sign-in, 1280x720@60 decoded/displayed, ~1 MiB/s inbound, no re-auth needed (refresh token valid and rotated normally).
Further gains on this metric would come from optimizing the harness sender, which does not transfer to the live Xbox stream (proxy success) - not attempted.

Live stats are now written to lab.log once per second by SessionController's rtc.onStats; the live receive path was measured on the simulator at 720p60: jb 2.3 ms, dec 4.1 ms, sub 0.08 ms, vsync wait (pres) 6.4 ms, rtt 4 ms median (spikes to ~70 ms), zero drops.

The video view requests 120 Hz via CADisplayLink.preferredFrameRateRange and Info.plist CADisableMinimumFrameDurationOnPhone, so ProMotion devices present on the next 120 Hz vsync; the simulator stays at 60 Hz so the lab metric is unchanged (6.00 ms).

Diagnostics are Debug-only now: LabLog.write takes an autoclosure and compiles to nothing in Release; the file rotates at 2 MiB to lab.log.1 (checked by pre-filling the simulator log). Production stats go through SessionEvents (Combine PassthroughSubject, throttled to one sample per 5 s) instead of disk logging.
next_candidates: Input-to-console cadence: the input loop is fixed at 8 ms (125 Hz) in XboxRTC; evaluate 4 ms against Xbox tolerance during live play (needs a controller).
Validate the 120 Hz vsync gain and the rtt spikes on a physical ProMotion iPhone; the simulator cannot show either.
